sources.title: Nemotron 3 Super technical report
sources.quote: filesystem isolation via a writable tmpfs overlay while sharing the host kernel.
sources.finding: NeMo-Gym SWE-RL launches task SIF images in Apptainer; OpenHands edits the repository, extracts a code patch, and ground-truth tests provide binary rewards. The report explicitly identifies writable tmpfs overlay.
sources.scope: Container isolation, not microVM or CXL migration.

sources.title: NeMo Gym SWE agent command construction
sources.finding: The current code launches a writable tmpfs overlay and bind-mounts params.persistent_dir at /trajectories_mount. Repository changes can be temporary while final artifacts are exported.
sources.scope: Current main independently corroborates the report; do not claim identical source version to the paper.

sources.title: NeMo Gym SWE Agents README
sources.locator: Artifact locations and cleanup; Agent flow per instance
sources.finding: Agent edits repository inside task SIF, produces patch; separate evaluation container tests it. Persistent per-run results and shared setup trees are distinct from temporary workspace writes.

sources.title: RL environments are an infra problem
sources.quote: each sandbox gets its own writable layer through an OverlayFS layer backed by a size-capped tmpfs.
sources.finding: Kolibri RL uses shared scratch SIF files, read-only squashfuse mounts shared by sandboxes, and a separate size-capped tmpfs writable overlay per sandbox. The post reports about 25,000 active sandboxes on average during the final training run.
sources.scope: Primary company engineering account; linked technical-report PDF timed out and was not used as evidence.

sources.title: DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec)
sources.quote: We place the writable layer on the node’s local disk
sources.finding: MicroVM overlayfs upper is a directory on a writable ext4 disk; OverlayBD and ublk provide on-demand reads and local writes. This is not evidence for tmpfs upper.

sources.title: Apptainer Persistent Overlays
sources.finding: --writable-tmpfs stores changes in an in-memory temporary filesystem and discards them when the container finishes; sessiondir max size controls its cap. Separate bind mounts may persist output.

sources.title: Docker OverlayFS storage driver
sources.finding: The classic overlay2 example stores image and writable layers under /var/lib/docker/overlay2 on the configured backing filesystem. OverlayFS alone does not imply tmpfs.

sources.title: Docker tmpfs mounts
sources.finding: Explicit tmpfs mounts differ from the writable container layer; contents disappear on container stop, count against memory limits, and may be swapped if swap is enabled.

sources.title: mini-swe-agent Singularity environment
sources.finding: Current backend builds a writable sandbox directory under tempfile.gettempdir and runs --writable. A temporary directory is not proof that its backing is tmpfs.

interpretation: RO image plus tmpfs upper is an established agent RL choice when temporary rollout workspace and exported artifacts suffice. This does not establish cross-host CXL microVM correctness or persistent writable-disk durability.
research_method: Primary reports, first-party engineering account, official source and runtime docs. Search results about only /tmp or /dev/shm were not counted as full workspace tmpfs evidence.
